user.title: Pair with your DARB hub
user.description:
On the hub, run `sudo darb-pair --ha` and paste the whole line it prints. It carries the hub's address and a key issued to Home Assistant alone. If you paste only the key, enter the hub address too.

{detail}

data.url: Hub address (only if you pasted a bare key)

pair.title: Pair with the DARB hub at {url}
pair.description:
Found on your network. On the hub, run `sudo darb-pair --ha` and paste the line it prints.

{detail}

reauth_confirm.title: Re-pair with DARB
reauth_confirm.description:
The hub at {url} no longer accepts Home Assistant's key, so it was revoked or the hub was reset. Run `sudo darb-pair --ha` on the hub and paste the new line.

{detail}

error.no_key: No key found. Paste the whole line from `darb-pair --ha`, or the 64-character key.
error.no_url: That was a bare key; enter the hub address too, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:8080.

abort.already_configured: This DARB hub is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: A DARB hub is already set up.

create_task.name: Propose a task
create_task.description: Proposes a task to DARB's Bot Herder, which checks it against each body's safety envelope before anything moves, and may delay or refuse it.

goal.name: Goal
goal.description: What should be done, in plain words.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: fetch, observe, say, show or plan.

required_capabilities.name: Required capabilities
required_capabilities.description: Only bodies with all of these are considered, e.g. see, grasp.

answer_approval.name: Answer an approval
answer_approval.description: Approves or denies a request waiting on a person. The request id is in the Approvals waiting sensor's attributes.
